The user wants to arrange a flight on booking number 1234 as soon as possible, and wants to check different options. They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_date 2024-10-31, travel_from first airport, travel_to last airport, travel_class business. Then we need to compute total payable amount. But what about booking? They want to arrange a flight on booking number 1234. That implies we might need to cancel existing booking? Or maybe they want to add a new flight to booking 1234? The user says "我需要在預訂編號 1234 上儘快安排一個航班". That could mean they want to book a flight under booking 1234. But booking 1234 might already exist. We might need to cancel it? Or maybe they want to add a flight to that booking. But the system likely expects a booking ID for cancellation. For booking a flight, we need an access token, card id, etc. We don't have those. We need to authenticate first. But we don't have client credentials. We might need to ask for them. But the user didn't provide. We might need to ask for client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, user_first_name, user_last_name. But the user didn't provide. We might need to ask. But the user didn't ask for authentication. We might need to proceed with flight cost calculation only. The user wants estimated total payable amount. That might just be the flight cost. But maybe also insurance? They didn't mention insurance. So just flight cost.

Thus we need to call get_all_airports to get list. Then get_flight_cost with travel_from first, travel_to last, travel_date 2024-10-31, travel_class business. Then provide cost. But we need to compute total payable amount. That might be just the cost. But maybe we need to include taxes? The get_flight_cost returns cost in USD. So that's the total.

Thus we need to call get_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then respond.

We don't need to authenticate or book. Just cost. So we can do that.

Let's call get_all_airports.
